'''Michael Tilley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Austin tournament (23 June)]] on 23 June 2001 with Training, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2501">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-23-austin-texas-6-23-01d2501/ austin-texas-6-23-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 23 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-23-austin-texas-6-23-01d2501/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
